name: Renewals Invoice Bot
tagline: Settles your recurring bills up to a fixed weekly limit, and asks before anything new
description: Takes the routine end of accounts payable off your desk: subscription renewals and the payment reminders that pile up each week are handled from its own machine, drawing on a budget you cap in advance. Anything outside the list you pre-approved stops and comes back to you for a decision.
author: compileinstyle
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
